# package iec60870

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5"
```

Package iec60870 is the module root of a pure Go implementation of the IEC 60870-5 telecontrol protocol family.

Applications import the subpackages:

  - [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/asdu](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/asdu): the application service data unit of IEC 60870-5-101 and IEC 60870-5-104 (the telecontrol companion standards), with configurable field sizes
  - [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/cp](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/cp): the time tags of IEC 60870-5-4 (CP24Time2a, CP32Time2a, CP56Time2a), shared by the companion standards that use them
  - [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/ft12](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/ft12): the FT 1.2 frame format of IEC 60870-5-1, the serial framing of IEC 60870-5-101, -102 and -103
  - [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/link](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/link): the link transmission procedures of IEC 60870-5-2 over FT 1.2, unbalanced and balanced
  - [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/telecontrol](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/telecontrol): the request procedures IEC 60870-5-101 and -104 share
  - [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101): IEC 60870-5-101 over a serial line or byte stream, with a controlling station ([github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/client](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/client)) and a controlled station ([github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/server](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/server))
  - [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102): IEC 60870-5-102 (integrated totals), its own ASDU model, client, server and the opt-in REE profile ([github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102/ree](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102/ree))
  - [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec103): IEC 60870-5-103 (protection equipment), its own ASDU model, client and server
  - [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec104](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec104): IEC 60870-5-104 over TCP/IP: APCI framing ([github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec104/apci](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec104/apci)), the controlling station ([github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec104/client](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec104/client)) and the controlled station ([github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec104/server](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec104/server))
  - [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/sec](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/sec): IEC 62351-5 application layer security as profiled by IEC TS 60870-5-7

This package holds what every companion standard shares: the [Logger](#type-logger) interfaces.

Docs: README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/STANDARDS.md, docs/FEATURE-STATUS.md, docs/ROADMAP.md.

## Types

### type ContextLogger

```go
type ContextLogger interface {
	Logger

	DebugContext(ctx context.Context, msg string, keysAndValues ...any)
	InfoContext(ctx context.Context, msg string, keysAndValues ...any)
	WarnContext(ctx context.Context, msg string, keysAndValues ...any)
	ErrorContext(ctx context.Context, msg string, keysAndValues ...any)
}
```

ContextLogger extends [Logger](#type-logger) with context-aware structured logging, so that a handler can pick trace and span identifiers out of the context. When the Logger also implements ContextLogger, entries that belong to a request are logged with the context the request was called with.

### type FieldLogger

```go
type FieldLogger interface {
	Logger

	// With returns a logger that adds the given fields to every entry.
	With(keysAndValues ...any) FieldLogger

	DebugKV(msg string, keysAndValues ...any)
	InfoKV(msg string, keysAndValues ...any)
	WarnKV(msg string, keysAndValues ...any)
	ErrorKV(msg string, keysAndValues ...any)
}
```

FieldLogger extends [Logger](#type-logger) with structured key-value logging. When the Logger given to a client or server also implements FieldLogger, the library logs through it: every entry is a constant message plus fields such as "component", "remote", "state", "type", "cause" and "error", instead of one formatted string. [NewSlogLogger](#func-newsloglogger) returns such a logger.

keysAndValues alternate string keys and values, as in log/slog.

#### func NewSlogFieldLogger

```go
func NewSlogFieldLogger(h slog.Handler) FieldLogger
```

NewSlogFieldLogger is [NewSlogLogger](#func-newsloglogger) with the result typed as a [FieldLogger](#type-fieldlogger), for callers that want to add fields with With before handing the logger to a client or server. A nil handler returns a no-op logger.

### type Logger

```go
type Logger interface {
	Debugf(format string, args ...any)
	Infof(format string, args ...any)
	Warnf(format string, args ...any)
	Errorf(format string, args ...any)
}
```

Logger is the logging interface accepted by the client and the server. Implement it to integrate any logging library.

Logging is silent by default. Methods are invoked synchronously on the protocol path and must not block.

#### func NewSlogLogger

```go
func NewSlogLogger(h slog.Handler) Logger
```

NewSlogLogger wraps a slog.Handler. The result implements [FieldLogger](#type-fieldlogger) and [ContextLogger](#type-contextlogger), so the library logs structured fields through it; messages are only built when the handler is enabled for their level. A nil handler returns a no-op logger.

#### func NewStdLogger

```go
func NewStdLogger(l *log.Logger) Logger
```

NewStdLogger wraps a standard library logger. Each message is prefixed with its level. A nil l logs to os.Stderr with the standard flags.

#### func NopLogger

```go
func NopLogger() Logger
```

NopLogger returns a Logger that discards everything.
